HealFlow FAQ

No. HealFlow has no sign-up, login, or account system. You can start using it right away, and everything is stored on your device.

No. Your records are stored locally on your device and are not transmitted to any server, because no such server exists for this app. The app does include optional analytics, crash-reporting, and advertising components — see the Privacy Policy's Analytics, Crash Reporting, and Remote Configuration and Advertising sections for exactly what each one can and cannot access.

You can create a local backup file from More → Backup & Restore. It is saved or shared using your device's normal share options, and is not encrypted, so store it somewhere only you can access.

You can restore a previously created backup file from More → Backup & Restore. Restoring replaces everything currently on this device.

App Lock is optional and can be turned on from More → Security. It supports a PIN and/or biometric unlock, both handled by your device; App Lock does not encrypt the database and does not block screenshots.

An advertising component is integrated in the app, but it is currently configured with Google's test ad unit IDs only. The app is not serving live ads at this time, and ads never have access to your health records.

Use Delete All Data at the bottom of More → Backup & Restore. This permanently removes your profile, records, documents, settings, and App Lock PIN from this device, and cannot be undone.

No. HealFlow works offline and stores everything on this device. An internet connection is only used for the optional analytics, crash-reporting, and advertising components described in the Privacy Policy.
